title: Quote from Ursala Franklin on Dangers of Prescriptive Technologies #el30
summary: The acculturation to compliance and conformity has, in turn, accelerated the use of prescriptive technologies in administrative, government, and social services. The same development has diminished resistance to the programming of people. this diminished resistance is the reason why we need to get people to do the hard work of owning your domain.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The acculturation to compliance and conformity has, in turn, accelerated the use of prescriptive technologies in administrative, government, and social services. The same development has diminished resistance to the programming of people.

 

this diminished resistance is the reason why we need to get people to do the hard work of owning your domain.
